name: Hokuriku Electric Power Company
summary: Hokuriku Electric Power Company supplies electricity through power generation, transmission, and distribution systems in Japan. The company generates electricity through hydroelectric, thermal, and nuclear sources. It is also involved in the sale of LNG; construction of thermal and nuclear power plant equipment; architecture, civil engineering, and paving works; design and construction business; maintenance of hydroelectric power generation substation; distribution facilities; electricity, air conditioning, water supply and drainage, communication equipment construction, and plumbing business; and manufacturing and sale of concrete poles and piles.
